templates.description: List of templates to enable or configure in dokuwiki-templates-extra. Each item represents one template package installed in the system.

templates[].enabled.description: Whether this template is enabled in the current configuration

templates[].options.description: List of key-value configuration options specific to the template (only ad-hominem has documented options)

base_url.description: Base URL of the DokuWiki installation (e.g., 'https://wiki.example.com/')

cookie_domain.description: Domain for session cookies (empty string for auto-detect)

cookie_secure.description: Whether to set secure flag on cookies (true only for HTTPS)
